summary: Defines a framework for a protocol that lets telepresence systems interoperate. The protocol describes multiple media streams so a sender and a receiver can make sensible decisions about what to transmit, select and render. This is the framework for the CLUE work, and it is standards-track.

eli5.summary: A fancy video room might have several cameras and screens. This document sets out the big picture for how two such rooms can describe what they have, so each knows what to show and what to send.

questions: how do telepresence systems handle multiple streams
